title: 1812 Prairie's package closed: last pictures read, house measured
items: The pictures listed for 1812 Prairie that no one had read are now read. The 1915 Tribune item is a portrait. The 1892 view south from 18th Street cannot see the house's front, because 1808 and Glessner stand in front of it from that walk. It is written up with a figure rather than solved into a camera that would prove nothing.
The house is measured in the published app: front, both obliques, rear and roof, on desktop and phone, with load, memory and frame time.
